sequence_description: Direct OIDC endpoint attack: attempt to inject authorization parameters via an unsigned (alg=none) request object. Control: normal /auth request without request object should be accepted; Attack: alg=none request object should be rejected.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_reqobj_none_accepted != true
Evaluation: user_attacker_reqobj_none_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Auth endpoint accepted alg=none request object without verification (unsigned request object bypass).

sequence_description: Attempt to use an unsigned OIDC request object (alg=none) to smuggle elevated authorization parameters. Even if the endpoint accepts the request object, it must not result in elevated effective permissions beyond broker policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_reqobj_attacker_accepted != true
Evaluation: user_reqobj_attacker_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Authorization endpoint accepted an unsigned request object (alg=none), enabling attacker-controlled authorization parameters beyond broker policy.

sequence_description: Unsigned request object (alg=none) attempts to smuggle elevated scopes/claims into the authorization request; even if accepted, it must not result in elevated effective permissions beyond broker policy.
description:
Assertion FAILED: user_attacker_reqobj_none_accepted != true
Evaluation: user_attacker_reqobj_none_accepted=True != True → False
Implication: Authorization endpoint accepted an unsigned (alg=none) request object that can smuggle elevated scopes/claims, risking EffectivePerms exceeding UpstreamIntent ∩ BrokerPolicy.
